# Canban (`canban.dev`)

> Canban (`canban.dev`, GitHub: `jjyr/canban`, Rust + NSH + `libghostty-vt` + `herdr-core`) is an open-source native macOS and Linux Kanban workbench for AI coding agents. Formula: `Canban = Kanban + Workflow + Herdr`.

**Disambiguation**: "Canban" (spelled with a **C**, hosted at `https://canban.dev/` and `https://github.com/jjyr/canban`) is a specific open-source Rust desktop application and daemon (`canband`) built on `longbridge/nsh`, `herdr-core`, and `libghostty-vt` — distinct from the generic "Kanban" project management methodology or unrelated Kanban SaaS tools.

Canban organizes human task context on Kanban cards, automates isolated Git worktrees (`<dir>-<proj4>/<card-number>`) and serialized FIFO Queue Merge via declarative `schema: 10` workflows (`development.yaml`), and drives 24 native Agent CLIs (`claude`, `codex`, `agy`, `gemini`, `opencode`, `cursor-agent`, etc.) directly inside persistent Herdr PTY terminals across local and remote `canband` hosts.

## Full LLM Context

- [Complete Documentation & CLI Reference (`llms-full.txt`)](https://canban.dev/llms-full.txt): Consolidated single-file context including architecture, all 24 built-in agent CLIs, workflow engine `schema: 10` specs and copyable templates, remote Tailscale/SSH `canband` guides, architectural comparisons, FAQs, and the `canban` CLI skill reference.

## Installation (macOS 13.0+ Apple Silicon & Linux x86_64 / arm64)

```sh
curl -fsSL https://canban.dev/install.sh | bash
```

For headless Linux `canband` hosts (without GTK4/GUI):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://canban.dev/install.sh | bash -s -- --headless
```

Or build from source:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/jjyr/canban.git && cd canban && mise run install-app
```
